scope: Four-pose breathing production draft, not player-integrated or a completed hairstyle. Uniform whole-frame composition; no per-pose fitting or pixel repairs.

records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Four registered hair-only layers for game animation.
Input1 is the EXACT geometry edit target, four bald poses arranged 2x2 on a 1254-square canvas, each cell627square. Input2 is a placement guide of the same bodies with green outer bounds. Input3 is the accepted short curly painted hair material/shape for the TOP LEFT pose, at twice the linear size: its whole canvas1254 corresponds to ONE627 cell here. Match its restrained short curls; no hanging curl or U-shaped loop behind/below the visible ear.
Imagine adding the SAME hairstyle directly onto all four target scalps then return ONLY the added hair. Leave bodies, faces, skin, ears, eyebrows and clothing fully transparent. Keep the exact 1254x1254 canvas and all four target positions; do not recenter any cap within its cell. The bodies' heads move slightly between poses; follow those crowns/forehead hairlines individually. No face/scalp backing, skin-coloured fragments, guide lines or background.
Hair remains approximately within these outer rectangles x,y,width,height: [245,20,167,147], [870,27,167,147], [240,649,167,147], [870,647,167,147]. They are limits, not shapes to fill. Actual caps hug scalp and stop above the ears. Top-left head crown near x335,y55; top-right near x950,y55; bottom-left near x322,y685; bottom-right near x950,y685. Forehead/eyes remain open; visible ears uncovered.
Warm broad painted dark brown curls, upper-left illumination, matching input3 at game scale. All four represent the same person's same hair, with consistent silhouette, volume and curl clusters. Most of canvas must be transparent empty space. No text, grids, shadows, props, checkerboard, resizing, rearrangement or cropping. Return hair ONLY, not bodies with hair.
records.findings: All four caps are oversized and misregistered across faces/shoulders. Coverage 0.218/0.227/0/0. Do not fit or reuse.
